title: Abaye bar Huna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Zevachim 62b, he reported in the name of Rav Chama bar Goria. It seems that the reading should be “Avin bar Huna,” who always reports in Rav Chama bar Goria’s name: the leg of the nun was cut off, leaving a yod.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman proposes that truncation of a nun’s leg produced a yod, changing Avin to Abaye.

The consulted Zevachim 62b reads Abaye bar Huna reporting Rav Chama bar Goria. Hyman’s proposal that the name should be Avin, and his explanation involving the loss of a nun’s leg, remain his textual conjecture. Neither the letter-level mechanism nor the claim about recurring transmissions has been independently established here.
